| # Object 0x1017 producer heartbeat time {#object-0x1017-producer-heartbeat-time-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                                                       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The producer heartbeat time defines the cycle time of the heartbeat.

If the time is 0 it is not used. The time has to be a multiple of 1 ms.

 

  Index           0x1017
  --------------- --------------------------------------------------
  Name            Producer Heartbeat Time
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 16
  Category        Conditional; Mandatory if guarding not supported
  Access          RW
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 16
  Default Value   0
